about: Under Night In-Birth Exe:Late[st] expands upon the original fighting game including new characters, a robust story mode, tutorial mode, enhanced online battles, and more! UNIELST strikes the perfect balance between accessibility and depth, offering an experience that both fighting game veterans and those new to the genre can enjoy! Choose from 20 unique characters and join them in their perilous journey through the Hollow Night.
